exclude_notes.^tc_clk_delay$: tech_cells_generic/src/rtl/tc_clk.sv declares it inside `ifndef SYNTHESIS and the manifest defines SYNTHESIS: not part of the design, the closure's text scan finds it anyway (read_uhdm: Module `tc_clk_delay' not found)
exclude_notes.^cc_stream_dv$: an INTERFACE (common_cells/src/cc_stream_intf.sv), not a module; the bound-wrapper retry has nothing to bind and reports Module `cc_stream_dv' not found
exclude_notes.^cc_clk_or_tree$: instantiates ITSELF three times (a recursive clock OR tree); yosys cannot flatten a design with recursive instantiations, so the miter's `flatten` refuses it on both frontends -- not a reader defect
exclude_notes.^cc_unread$: a sink with an input and NO output (common_cells/src/cc_unread.sv, body only under `ifdef TARGET_VIVADO); both frontends read it to an empty module that opt deletes, and the miter reports `Can't find gold module`
exclude_notes.^tc_sram_blackbox$: an empty BLACKBOX shell for a technology SRAM; no body to compare (`Can't find gold module`)
exclude_notes.^tc_sram$: instantiates tc_sram_blackbox, so the miter has `No SAT model available` for the blackbox cell; the behavioural tc_sram_wrapper row covers the SRAM model
